dedupe_keys.name: quarterly results for retail telecommunications sectors and broadcasting distribution

description: Quarterly results for retail telecommunications sectors and broadcasting distribution is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission | Conseil de la radiodiffusion et des télécommunications canadiennes. This dataset shows the quarterly retail telecommunications revenues by sectors, BDU revenues, number of lines and subscribers of retail telecommunication services and BDU services, and growth rates. Wholesale revenues are excluded from the dataset. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission | Conseil de la radiodiffusion et des télécommunications canadiennes. Its tags are Télécommunications, Radiodiffusion, Entreprise de distribution de radiodiffusion, EDR, Statistique. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, TXT, XLSX. The portal shows 2018-08-14 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
